text:
Predicates:
MonkeypoxVirus(x) ::: Monkeypox virus occurs in x.
Monkeypox(x) ::: x gets Monkeypox.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Symptom(x, y) ::: x is a symptom of y.
Fever(x) ::: x has fever.
Headache(x) ::: x has headache.
MusclePain(x) ::: x has muscle pains.
Tiredness(x) ::: x feels tired.
Flu(x) ::: x gets the flu.
Premises:
∃x (MonkeypoxVirus(x) → Monkeypox(x)) ::: When the Monkeypox virus occurs in a being, it may get Monkeypox.
∃x (Animal(x) ∧ MonkeypoxVirus(x)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals.
∀x (Human(x) → Mammal(x)) ::: Humans are mammals.
∀x (Mammal(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Mammals are animals.
∃x (Symptom(x, Monkeypox) ∧ (x = fever ∨ x = headache ∨ x = musclePain ∨ x = tiredness)) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, and tiredness.
∀x (Flu(x) → Tiredness(x)) ::: People feel tired when they get the flu.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Flu(x)) ::: No one gets the flu.
